title: Hedgehog eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='38' ry='8' fill='#2e7d32' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- hedgehog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#c98a3b'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='22' ry='12' fill='#f0c878'/>
  <!-- spikes on back -->
  <g fill='#6b4a1f'>
    <polygon points='25,62 30,45 36,60'/>
    <polygon points='33,56 39,38 45,54'/>
    <polygon points='42,52 49,34 55,51'/>
    <polygon points='52,51 58,35 64,52'/>
    <polygon points='61,54 68,40 73,58'/>
    <polygon points='70,60 76,46 80,62'/>
  </g>
  <!-- spike highlights -->
  <g fill='#a5781e'>
    <polygon points='29,58 31,49 35,58'/>
    <polygon points='44,52 49,41 53,52'/>
    <polygon points='63,55 68,46 71,57'/>
  </g>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='70' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#e0a44e'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='73' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#f5cf8a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='94' cy='72' r='3' fill='#4a2f10'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='65' r='3' fill='#2a1a08'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='64' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='58' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#d99a42'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='59' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#f0c878'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='85' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#b5762a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='86' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#b5762a'/>
  <!-- arms holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='82' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#d99a42'/>
  <!-- snack: apple -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='85' r='6' fill='#e53935'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='83' r='1.5' fill='#ff8a80'/>
  <!-- apple stem -->
  <rect x='87.5' y='77' width='1.5' height='4' fill='#5d4037'/>
  <!-- apple leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='78' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#4caf50' transform='rotate(-30 91 78)'/>
  <!-- bite mark -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='87' r='2' fill='#f5cf8a'/>
</svg>
